parameters.name: frame_width
parameters.generation_rule: Frame/insert/decoration: exact affine X-scale about X=0 (dX/dp = X/frame_width_default). Lens/temple/hinge/joint assemblies: rigid outward translation of frame_width_delta/2 per side.

parameters.name: lens_width
parameters.generation_rule: Lens: exact affine X-scale about own LM_*LensCenter.x. Frame: SAME formula applied to every Frame vertex, weighted by smoothstep(1 - d/12mm) where d = distance to nearest vertex of that lens. 12mm falloff radius measured from actual geometry (90th/99th percentile of Frame-to-lens distance at rest, see build_basis.py docstring).
parameters.quality_metric: lens_rim_boundary_error_mm (engine.lens_rim_boundary_error_mm) - measured 0.0005mm at +5% (target: stay near the 0.02mm rest-state gap)

parameters.name: lens_height
parameters.generation_rule: Same method as lens_width, applied to Z about LM_*LensCenter.z.

parameters.name: bridge_width
parameters.generation_rule: Lens: rigid +-0.5*delta X-shift (unchanged from v1). Frame: rigid-direction X-shift weighted by smoothstep(1 - d_to_bridge_center/22mm), so Frame moves with the lens near the nasal/bridge area and tapers to exactly 0 well before the hinge (measured: nearest Frame vertex to LM_LeftHinge is 45mm+ from bridge center, radius is 22mm, so zero overlap risk).
parameters.known_limitation: At large deltas (tested at max range, 28mm) local edge stretch in the bridge falloff band reaches ~18mm distortion - the smoothstep falloff is C1-continuous but not shape-preserving under large pushes. Acceptable for the +-5% test range (1.6mm measured) but a proper ARAP/biharmonic solve would be needed for full-range production quality.
parameters.quality_metric: bridge_continuity_error_mm (engine.bridge_continuity_error_mm) - measured 1.6mm at +5% (delta=0.9mm), 18.0mm at max range (delta=10.1mm)

parameters.name: temple_length
parameters.generation_rule: Affine scale along each temple's root->tip axis (LM_*TempleRoot -> LM_*TempleTip), pivoting at the root so the hinge attachment point never moves.
parameters.known_limitation: LeftTempleJoint/RightTempleJoint are rigid and do not stretch with the temple - large deltas could visually separate temple from joint housing.

formula: V(p) = V0 + sum_i( B[:,:,i] * (p_i - default_i) ),  p_i in mm, default in mm
unified_vertex_order: matches masks.json part_masks (index ranges), which matches part_order in _part_order.json and the GLB node order
symmetry_note: All 5 basis vectors are constructed from geometry that was pre-verified as mirror-symmetric to <1e-6mm, and each rule treats Left/Right identically (same formula, mirrored sign or mirrored landmark) - symmetry is structurally preserved by construction, not just checked after the fact.
changelog: v1.1: lens_width, lens_height, bridge_width now couple the Frame rim (previously Frame was completely unaffected by these 3 params - the lens visibly separated from the rim at any nontrivial delta).

v1.1: bridge_width no longer moves Hinge/Temple/TempleJoint (was incorrectly duplicating frame_width's job) - it is now a local nasal/rim parameter only. frame_width remains the whole-assembly parameter.
